## Name the stage and standard

A draft for feedback needs a different check from a paper you're about to submit. Decide what you'll use this version for, then choose the matching standard.

## Try this now

1. Write who will read or use the work and what they need from it.
2. Use the stage rubric linked below to check this version.
3. Fix problems with safety, integrity, approval, evidence or reproducibility before optional improvements.
4. Ask the relevant reviewer to confirm it's ready. Keep other refinements for later unless they address a real problem.

## What to take when asking

Show your reviewer the work, the checks you've completed and anything that still needs attention. Ask whether it's ready for its next use.

## Stop or change route

A deadline can't resolve a failed critical check. Equally, another possible improvement doesn't automatically justify delaying work that meets the agreed standard.

## You are moving again when

The critical checks pass, or the responsible reviewer has explicitly resolved them, and you know what happens next.

Use the [good-enough rubric](../checklists/good-enough-rubric.qmd) and the relevant phase checklist.
